claims.verbatim:
Steamship Tripoli (Br), Harrison, Liverpool Sept 12, via
Queenstown 13th, with mdse and 499[?] passengers, to E Cu
nard. Sept 14, lat 51 18, lon 10 40, passed steamship Persia,
hence for Liverpool; 20th, lat 49 22, lon 35 52[?], bark Godolphe,
bound E, and bark Anastasia, bound W; 25th, lat 43 35, lon
59 10, steamship Hermann, hence for Bremen.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 10 September 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of Boston (Br), Brooks, Liverpool Aug 29,
via Queenstown 30th, with mdse and 665[?] passengers, to John
G Dale. Aug 30, 18 miles NE of Tuskar, passed steamship
Erin, hence for Liverpool; same day, 12 miles west of Tus-
kar, steamship Etna; 31st, 45[?] miles west of Fastnet, steam-
ship Java—both hence for Liverpool; Sept 2, lat 40[?] 55[?], lon 27
36[?], ship Transit, bound W; 5th, 257 miles E of Cape Race,
steamship City of Paris, hence for Liverpool; 6th, off Cape
Race, an extra Cunard steamer, bound W; 7th, lat 43, lon 61[?]
07, steamship Persia, hence for Liverpool; 9th, 178 miles
W of Sandy Hook, steamship City of New York, do for do;
a Bremen steamer, bound E; also steamships Pennsylvania,
Britannia, Napoleon III, and William Penn—all bound E.

claims.verbatim:
Steamship Hecla (Br), Edmonson, Liverpool Aug 28, via
Queenstown 29th, with mdse and 419 passengers, to E Cu-
nard. Has had strong westerly winds the entire passage.
Aug 29, 10:30 PM, spoke brig Hibernia, bound up Channel;
Sept 5, 10 AM, 240 miles E of Cape Race, exchanged signals
with bark Princess, of Liverpool, bound W; 7th, 6 PM, lat 42
47, lon 60 20, passed steamship Persia, hence for Liverpool;
9th, 2:20 PM, 240 miles E of Sandy Hook, steamship Napo-
leon III, hence for Havre.
